subject: Draft: Marketplace landing narrative and trial entitlement copy
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@acme-corp.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 15:06:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace listing draft + trial question

Hi Soojin / Kimberly,

Thanks for jumping on this with us. Attached is our first pass at the AWS Marketplace product page copy and hero blurb (acme_listing_draft.docx). We're preparing for a listing slot in the next two weeks and want to confirm a couple of items before we finalize: 

- Trial length: our product team recommends a 30-day trial but procurement prefers 14 days for entitlement controls — can Redwood support a 30-day privateoffer trial?
- CTA phrasing: we used "Start 30-day trial" in the hero; curious if you recommend anything more marketplace-friendly (e.g., "Try on AWS" or "Get started (trial)").
- Pricing footnote: we currently say "Metered by inference unit/min" — is that acceptable or should we adopt Redwood's suggested phrasing?

We'd appreciate line edits directly in the doc and any notes about AMI visibility / SKU mapping for BYO or standard AMIs. Goal: finalize copy by EOD Nov 24 so internal approvals can run.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Corp

Attachment: acme_listing_draft.docx (document, 18kb)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@acme-corp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 17:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing draft + trial question

Hi Alice — thanks for the draft and timeline. Quick responses inline and attached a PDF with comments (soojin_acme_comments.pdf).

- Trial length: Redwood Marketplace listings can surface a 30-day trial if you choose that for Private Offers, but for the public listing standard trials we typically recommend 14 days to reduce accidental overage and to align with buyer expectations. For Enterprise customers we usually enable a 30-day Private Offer trial; if you want the public hero to say 30-day we should add a short procurement note and expected entitlement language.

- CTA phrasing: I suggest "Start free trial on AWS" for the hero (keeps action + platform). Short A/B friendly copy variants: "Try on AWS" / "Start free trial".

- Pricing footnote: replace "inference unit/min" with "metered per inference-second" — it's clearer for buyers and matches our billing taxonomy. Kimberly, can you confirm the billing phrase?

I've left margin notes around the hero copy and condensed the benefits bullets so they fit the marketplace snippet limit. Also added a recommended short demo script for the field team.

Next steps I propose:
1) Soojin to publish edited doc with suggested hero + footnote (action: me)
2) Kimberly to confirm AMI + SKU gating notes (action: Kimberly)
3) Marissa to schedule listing slot and confirm launch window (action: Marissa)

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing draft + trial question

Thanks for the draft — I added more technical notes and attached a quick SKU mapping export (sku_mapping.csv) and AMI tagging notes (ami-notes.txt). High-level items: 

- AMI visibility: For BYO AMIs we need the seller to provide the correct sellerid/ami mapping in the listing metadata; public AMIs are fine but require the standard AMI claim. If Acme wants a 30-day public hero, we must ensure entitlements are gated (Private Offer + Marketplace license) so buyers don't get accidental extended trials.

- Trial enforcement: Redwood supports both 14 and 30-day trials, but enforcement is determined by entitlement policy attached to the SKU. I recommend 14 days on the public page and offer a 30-day Private Offer for named accounts (procurement-friendly).

- Pricing footnote: agree with Soojin — use "metered per inference-second" and add a short line: "Charges displayed are estimates; final billing is per monthly invoice." Keeps compliance folks happy.

- UX note: shorten the hero claim to one line (30 chars) and move the value bullets into the detail accordion.

Related hubspot: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/HS-12345

- Soojin: please update the hero to "Start free trial on AWS" and swap the pricing footnote to "metered per inference-second". Add a short procurement note that 30-day trials are available via Private Offer. (Due: EOD Nov 24)
- Kimberly: confirm AMI tagging requirements and whether Acme needs to provide a seller-owned AMI or use the public AMI flow. If seller-owned, confirm sellerid format. (Due: Nov 25)

I'll book a 30-minute sync for Thursday to finalize copy and confirm the listing slot (calendar invite to follow). I'll also upload the consolidated draft to Drive and attach the HubSpot deal; Alice, please review the GDrive link once it's up.
